description: Every local rank function on a transitive set agrees with global membership rank at every point of its domain; thus overlapping carriers give the same ranks.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.FoundationAndRank.local_rank_agrees.{u} (T : ZFSet.{u}) (hT : T.IsTransitive) (r : ↥T → Ordinal.{u})
  (hr : Lemmatheca.Entry.FoundationAndRank.LocalRankEquation T r) (x : ↥T) : r x = (↑x).rank
